description: This Java class defines the default implementation of MQTT configuration for the connectivity messaging service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages a configuration parameter 'sourceBufferSize' loaded from a config file and provides standard methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultMqttConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MqttConfig interface, representing MQTT connection configuration with a focus on source buffer size setting.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating a DefaultMqttConfig instance from a provided Config object, utilizing fallback configuration.

methods.name: getSourceBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the source buffer for MQTT messaging.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultMqttConfig instances based on sourceBufferSize.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for consistent hashing based on sourceBufferSize.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the config instance, listing sourceBufferSize.
